queries.sql: SELECT s.sales_invoice, s.sales_date, s.total_amount, s.product_vat, s.other_charge_on_all, s.paid_amount, s.due_amount, c.customer_name AS customer_name, u.user_name AS seller_name, CASE WHEN s.due_amount <= 0 THEN 'Fully Paid' WHEN s.paid_amount <= 0 THEN 'Unpaid' ELSE 'Partially Paid' END AS payment_status FROM sales s LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.user_id = s.seller_id ORDER BY s.sales_date DESC, s.sales_id DESC
